test.result: 3 passed; Ruff and mypy passed for performance_report.py.

implemented: Cohort summary reports annualized return, annualized volatility, Sharpe, Sortino, maximum drawdown and profit factor from daily net returns.
Mean daily net alpha is reported from the matched alpha input; one-way turnover mean and total are included when complete.
Every report declares scheduled denominator, observed and missing sessions, sample start/end and calendar duration, periods per year, annual risk-free rate, and annualization convention.
Missing returns keep their scheduled dates in the denominator and withhold the core performance metrics; unscheduled rows are rejected.
limitations: This report requires net NAV returns and matched-alpha values from upstream evidence; it does not validate the source market data or cost ledger.
